result.summary: Removes 21.ninja from the seed data sources documented for `makeseeds.py` in `contrib/seeds/README.md`. It also cleans up obsolete documentation referencing sipa's previously removed seed and virtu's crawler.
result.problem: The seed list on 21.ninja has been unmaintained since May 2026 after its operator stepped away from development. Continuing to pull from an abandoned source feeds stale node addresses into release seeds and risks address poisoning if the domain expires or is hijacked.
evidence: "The seeds.txt.gz file was last generated on 2026-05-22... about 6 months old now, and probably 10 months when used for the next release. There is no point in feeding (mostly) stale addresses into makeseeds.py and keeping the domain around just risks someone else getting access to the host or domain to insert malicious or fake addresses into it." (PR description)
"My understanding is that the owner of 21.ninja stepped away from Bitcoin development and probably will not maintain the seeder going forward." (PR description)
result.changed_since_previous: No functional changes to the commits; the previous description was recorded without a patch.
result.card: This PR removes 21.ninja from the release seed generation instructions in contrib/seeds/README.md and drops obsolete references to previously retired seeds. The 21.ninja crawler has been unmaintained since May 2026, meaning makeseeds.py would ingest stale addresses and expose static seed generation to domain hijacking risks if the host is ever compromised. Removing dormant sources maintains the integrity of hardcoded seeds compiled into releases.

risk.why: It only updates documentation and curl commands in contrib/seeds for maintainers generating release seeds.
